mapper.select: SELECT dh.require_doc_id, dh.file_name, dh.file_url, dh.create_user_name, dh.create_time, dh.change_version, dh.upload_type, tdd.docs_name AS requireDocName FROM task_doc_history dh LEFT JOIN task_delivery_docs tdd ON dh.require_doc_id=tdd.id WHERE dh.is_deleted=FALSE AND dh.is_change_success=TRUE AND dh.finish_doc_id=#{finishDocsId} ORDER BY dh.change_version ASC
